title: Glacier melt rates
text: Alpine glaciers lost mass faster during the last decade. Meltwater runoff peaks in late summer and feeds the rivers below.

title: Coral bleaching
text: Warm ocean water stresses reef corals, which expel their symbiotic algae. Bleached reefs recover slowly when the water cools.

title: Honeybee navigation
text: Foraging honeybees use a waggle dance to tell hive mates the direction and distance of flowers.

title: Soil microbes
text: Fungal networks in forest soil move nitrogen between tree roots. Disturbed soil holds fewer of these fungi.

title: Volcanic ash
text: Fine volcanic ash can travel thousands of kilometres and disrupts aviation by damaging jet engines.
Tidal pools host small crabs, anemones and snails that survive daily changes in temperature and salinity.
